title: Meningococcal Disease and College Students — Recommendations of the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP), MMWR Recomm Rep 2000;49(RR-7)

claims.text: Following control of Haemophilus influenzae type b, N. meningitidis is the leading cause of bacterial meningitis in U.S. children and young adults.
